description:
Build a cult and crusade through four corrupted regions. Archipelago gates those regions and
scatters the weapons, curses, sermons, tarot cards and Divine Inspiration upgrades across the
multiworld.

v0.9.0-beta.1.description:
The first public beta. Play Cult of the Lamb in an Archipelago multiworld.

## What to download

| File | Who needs it |
|------|--------------|
| `Archipelago_CultOfTheLamb-0.9.0.zip` | Every player. Install through r2modman, or drop it into `BepInEx/plugins`. Also on [Thunderstore](https://thunderstore.io/c/cult-of-the-lamb/). |
| `cult_of_the_lamb.apworld` | Whoever generates the seed. Goes in `custom_worlds/` in your Archipelago install. |

Requires BepInEx 5.4.2101 for Cult of the Lamb, and Archipelago 0.6.6 or newer.

The [README](https://github.com/IanCichy/CultOfTheLamb_Archipelago#readme) has the full setup, every option, and how to write your YAML.

## What's in it

- Region access gated behind Progressive Bishop's Domain items
- Weapons, curses, sermon upgrades, tarot cards and Divine Inspiration as multiworld items and checks
- Optional checks for follower milestones, Snail Shrine offerings, tarot shop slots, buildings and sweeping
- Three goals: a number of Bishops, a number of Witnesses, or Narinder
- Woolhaven DLC support behind `include_woolhaven`
- Pacing caps so a seed fits in a session rather than the game's own curve
- Connect from the pause menu, an AP checklist in the quest log, a popup for every check, and base displays for your collections

The [changelog](https://github.com/IanCichy/CultOfTheLamb_Archipelago/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) lists all of it.

## Before you start

**Use a save dedicated to Archipelago.** With `randomize_tarot_cards` on, connecting takes the managed cards out of your collection and hands them back as items. Adding the mod to an existing game has not been tested.

**Connect after your save has loaded**, not from the main menu. Right after you load into your cult is the best time.

**Tarot cards are the one thing offline play loses.** Everything else you do while disconnected gets sent when you reconnect, but a card unlocked offline sends no check and is taken back. Earn cards while connected.

## It's a beta

Multiple full multiworlds have been played and completed on this, but it hasn't had many hands on it yet. If something looks wrong, press **F9** in game to dump the mod's state to the log, then [open an issue](https://github.com/IanCichy/CultOfTheLamb_Archipelago/issues) with `LogOutput.log` and your YAML.

v0.9.1.description:
### Fixed

- Beating Narinder now reports the goal.
- Max health no longer climbs past the game's ceiling when a batch of items arrives on connect.
- Universal Tracker shows the right starting region.
- The sermon XP cap is logged as the number you set, not the game's internal value.
- Deleting a save no longer leaves its Archipelago badge on the empty slot, or stops the save
  menu refreshing.
- Seeds no longer fail to generate when two Cult of the Lamb players share an item link.
- A save started without Quick Start no longer stalls. The tutorial's Divine Inspiration point is
  left alone until it finishes, and the free upgrades wait until then.
- Gusion and Eligos no longer send each other's checks in Anura. Existing seeds keep the old
  names, so regenerate to pick this up.
v0.9.1.title: v0.9.1

v0.9.2.description:
### Added

- Death Link, off by default. `death_link_cooldown` sets how long to ignore further deaths after
  one lands, and `death_link_faith_loss` what one costs your cult in Faith.
- Permadeath saves are never killed by a received death. They still send their own.
